cash_ledger_join: Design 2.1:75, 3:100 step 11 and 13:376. The compared window contains exactly the evaluation-bar exit fill F0, so it carries one FEE cash row (-0.0405, joined to fee_events/0) and one GROSS_REALIZATION cash row (-10), in that fill order. Only cash_events are applied to equity. The pre-window entry fill at 2000-01-01T00:11:00Z charges its own ENTRY fee of 0.045 (fee_notional 100 * 1 * 1), which is why equity_curve.first is 1000 - 0.045 = 999.955 rather than 1000; equity_curve.last = 999.955 + (-0.0405) + (-10) = 989.91450000000009. The equity curve is therefore window-scoped and satisfies the invariant last = first + sum(in-window cash signed deltas). net_trade_pnl is lifecycle-scoped per design 13:378 and includes the pre-window entry fee, so fee_total -0.085499999999999993 is NOT the sum of the in-window cash rows. Re-derived under design 23.2:1057-1064, which now fixes the window-scoped reading V15-D02 flagged as unfixed; the design labels that scope an AMENDMENT-CHOICE (:1066-1072).
